original_question: The number of students in a school hall was 1000. The hall had 3 entrances A, B, and C which also served as the exits. If after a meeting 30% of the students went out of the building through exit A, 3/5 of the remaining went out through exit B, and the rest went out through exit C, calculate the number of students who went out through exit C.
question_template: The number of students in a school hall was {num_digit_1, 1000}. The hall had {num_digit_2, 3} entrances A, B, and C which also served as the exits. If after a meeting {num_digit_3, 30}% of the students went out of the building through exit A, {num_frac_1, 3/5} of the remaining went out through exit B, and the rest went out through exit C, calculate the number of students who went out through exit C.
question_solution: answer = num_digit_1 * (1 - num_digit_3/100) * (1 - f1)   # f1 is the numeric value of num_frac_1
